header: Unit conversion for the search bar: "5 km in miles", "98.6 f to c", "1 bhp in kw", "180 degrees to radians", "2 kgf/cm2 to bar". This file is pure: a table of units with their factor to the base unit of their kind, and a strict parser. I store nothing and send nothing anywhere. Where a word has more than one meaning, I record in the table which meaning I took, and the answer SAYS SO (a note): "ton" (metric tonne), "bhp"/"hp" (mechanical, 745.7 W) against "PS" (metric, 735.5 W), "calorie" (the small calorie; a food Calorie is the kilocalorie), "gallon" (US; the imperial gallon is separate).

behaviours: area, including Indian use
katha (cottah, kottah) and bigha, the West Bengal sizes: 1 katha = 720 sq ft, 1 bigha = 20 katha = 14,400 sq ft
chhatak and decimal: 16 chhatak = 1 katha, 100 decimal = 1 acre, a bigha is about 33 decimal
the Assam katha is 2,880 sq ft and five make one bigha; the Patna katha and bigha are 1,361.25 and 27,225 sq ft
a bare katha or bigha says which size it took, and the other states' sizes are named in their own notes
katha and bigha are area units, so they refuse a length
the area list of the converter card holds the new units, with places in their names
mass, including quintal and tola
temperature: the degree sign
angle: degrees and radians both ways
energy: calories, kcal, kWh, BTU, joule
power: bhp and kW both ways, PS and TR
pressure: bar, psi, kgf/cm2
speed and time
'what is', 'convert', thousand separators and a trailing ?
the answer reports one unit too
a word with several meanings says which it took
units of different kinds are told apart, not converted
a temperature cannot become a length
not a conversion: a sentence, an unknown unit, a bare number, other joiners
a very long text is refused
aliases do not collide: every alias names one unit
every unit is reachable by its own alias and a round trip returns the value
a conversion without a number is for one unit, as Google reads it; ordinary words are not units
a conversion names the ids of its two units, for the converter card
tables are complete
